title: Favourite vibe coded games
author: kan05
selftext:
What’s your favourite vibe coded game or game which has been mostly developed with AI? Have been looking to see what sorts of games have made success as a mostly vibe coded project to checkout what they’re doing different to other vibe coded games.

Have always developed games as a hobby and now use AI to assist with projects, so I’m interested to see what successfully AI games are doing to reach the point of success.

Feel the vibes!

comments.author: Acrobatic-Bit-1531
comments.body:
story is the ONLY thing keeping me in any of these tbh.

  
most of the browser roguelikes people post here lose me in twenty minutes. cute loop, nothing to care about, tab closed. what i actually keep open is character stuff, and my whole problem with character stuff is the melt. you know the melt?? week one the guy has an attitude and a grudge, by week three every single one of them is the same eager little helper going of course, whatever you want, and the arc is dead and im talking to a customer service bot in a cloak.

  
been in worldos a couple months and what got me is a merc i sold out in like my second session who still would not work with me twenty something sessions later. he brought it up himself. his grudge just stayed canon and i had to eat it. also i can walk into a world somebody else already built, because i do NOT want to sit there writing a setting for an hour before anything happens to me.

  
it does nothing unless i type though. nothing moves on its own, it will sit there waiting on me forever, and some nights that is just homework with a fantasy skin. online only too, which ate a four hour train ride last month, no signal, blank screen, i stared at a tunnel wall.

  
anyway what are you all playing for the story side... everything recced in this thread so far is a physics toy with a leaderboard

comments.author: BRaiNDED_Games
comments.body:
Nelly Jellies (posted in here) is deff a well made vibe-coded game, very polished. 

I would also toss my own game [Void Descent](http://braindedgames.itch.io/void-descent) out there. I've received good feedback from various reddit communities and I'm proud of how far it's come from where I started 10 months back.

replies.author: cli6kcla3k
replies.body: doesn't work when I was clicking on the 'best for my device' box

replies.author: BRaiNDED_Games
replies.body:
Sounds like you were on the graphics mode screen. If you're on iOS you may have issues with the 3d mode due to apples browser security systems.

If you select 2d mode you should be good, or either mode on android / PC.

There's also a button at the bottom to confirm your selection, if you're on a particularly small / short display maybe that's hidden? Let me know what device you're using and I can troubleshoot!
